pending_fixes.description: 3 place settings still need a manual change directly in the Studio UI (confirmed NOT MCP-scriptable this session -- reading Lighting.Technology via execute_luau throws 'lacking capability RobloxScript'): Lighting.Technology = Future (mandatory per architecture -- ShadowMap/Voxel breaks the ripeness-glow mechanic), a StreamingTargetRadius-equivalent workspace streaming radius setting, Players.MaxPlayers = 6.

Trip-time/richness balance hasn't had a real pass against the corrected, now-live patch distances (72-674 studs) -- a balance pass over Config.SPECIES distances or FORAGING constants, deferred until worth prioritizing over new features/bugs.

MAJOR GAP: Old Molasses (the bear raid system) is ONE OF THE THREE THINGS architecture.md itself says 'make this not a reskinned tycoon' -- a full 6-stage learning antagonist with two permanent mutually-exclusive endings, called out by name in the Emotional Journey table at the 20-26 minute mark. Confirmed via live MCP search: ZERO references to 'Molasses' anywhere in the entire game tree, no EnemyAI script, no ThreatService, and the Pine Treeline/Bear Lane/Molasses Den world zone (fully spec'd in architecture.md, ~150 parts, position centered (0,0,+105) plus a perimeter run) does not exist at all. Architecture.md's spec for this zone is complete and precise -- dimensions, part budget, pathfinding minimums (bear lane 16 studs, fence gaps 12 studs, AgentRadius 6/AgentHeight 26/AgentCanJump false), the full wasp cycle (SwatWasp remote, 4-7min scout timer, guard auto-kill threshold), and Molasses's full 6-stage table (patience/theft % per stage, the stage-6 BearOffering fork) -- this is a BUILD task (world-builder + luau-scripter + enemy-designer), not an architect-scoping task like Queen tiers needed.

A wider sweep of architecture.md's Tags table against live CollectionService tag counts found several more unbuilt systems: Smoker (0 tagged, bear-defense interact), GuardPerch (0, guard bee visual anchor), SwarmPerch (0, prestige interact -- ties to the also-missing SwarmService), WardrobePad (0, cosmetics -- ties to the also-missing CosmeticService), BudButton (0, physical structure-purchase buttons -- StructureService's own header comment explicitly confirms it only wires ApiaryShed/PropolisKiln tier purchases and explicitly defers Dance Floor tier, Comb Floor unlocks, Wardrobe and Swarm Perch pending CosmeticService/SwarmService, neither of which exists). No Weather system (Clear/Breezy/Overcast/Rain/Bloom Rush cycle) found either. RECOMMENDATION for future cycles: tackle Threats (wasps+Molasses) next -- most narratively central, fully spec'd, no architect ambiguity -- then physical structure buttons/Smoker/GuardPerch, then SwarmService+SwarmPerch, then CosmeticService+WardrobePad, then Weather, in roughly that priority order.

Architecture.md's Door/Connection Map literally says 'Wild Meadow -> open, Z -266..-386 (Gen-gated patches only) -> deep meadow', but that exact Z-range (-266 to -386) is ALSO the Apiary Yard hub's own spec'd footprint ('Dimensions: 140x140 X -70..+70, Z -406..-266') -- these two zones were never spatially reconciled in the design doc itself, which likely explains why Patch17_Fireweed/Patch18_AuroraBloom were originally built at Z=-286/-341 (inside the Hub) in the first place. This session's fix (buglist #50) pragmatically resolved the resulting collision by placing them at the real MeadowSoil's far corners instead. Flagging for awareness, not re-litigating -- the current fix works and is verified.

QueenService architect scoping complete (D:/Roblox/project-beesworld/gamemaster/architecture_queen_addendum.md) -- comprehensive, fact-checked spec ready for a build dispatch (luau-scripter + world-builder for Queen templates + ui-designer for HiveGui QUEEN tab). Key findings: outputMult/layInterval already live and consumed, unlocksNurse already effectively gated via Config.CASTES.nurse.requiresQueenTier, unlocksGoldenComb/unlocksSwarm/unlocksFloor3 correctly scoped OUT (their target features don't exist yet) via a single QueenService.HasUnlock(profile,flag) reader for future systems to call. Real gap found: Royal Cell Royal Jelly production (0.004/s per adjacent Brood cell) was never implemented anywhere -- without it the Laying Queen takes ~2.5 weeks of daily logins, so the spec makes this a required part of the build. Queens are deliberately rendered CLIENT-ONLY (0 server parts) per architecture.md's own 'server never moves a bee' rule, a disclosed deviation from the doc's literal 'QueenService spawns on server' wording. CRITICAL SIDE-FINDING (see id 9).

The QueenService architect found two ServerScriptService.Systems.DataService ModuleScript instances with byte-identical Source (16,128 chars) still sitting in the live Studio project -- almost certainly leftover from an earlier agent's 'clone the ModuleScript to bust require() cache' verification technique (used repeatedly this session) where the clone was never destroyed. Systems:FindFirstChild/WaitForChild resolve to the first one so gameplay is probably unaffected today, but this is a live landmine: if anything ever resolves the second instance, it would run its own separate DataService session-table, potentially splitting/losing player profile data. MUST be independently confirmed and resolved (delete whichever instance is NOT the one Systems:FindFirstChild('DataService') returns, then re-verify count==1) before any further work touches DataService, and definitely before this feature ships.

notes: New project, kept fully separate from the completed WICKWOOD build (D:/Roblox/project-survival/) and the paused Color Lock project (D:/Roblox/project/). Git branch: add-beesworld-project. IMPORTANT LESSON LEARNED this session: a task that built NotifyGui/HelpGui entirely via the Server datamodel during a live Play session was silently lost when the session ended -- Server-datamodel changes made during Play mode are ephemeral and never persist to the saved place. Going forward, any actual BUILD step (new GUIs/scripts/persistent edits) must use genuine Edit-mode calls, even if that means asking the user to briefly pause their test first; live Play-mode access should be treated as read-only/ephemeral-verification-only.
